name: read_merino
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
L=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(L/'sources/merino-prior.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'sources/merino-prior.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0;print(r.stdout)
